visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a young woman undergoing a professional skin analysis at a brightly lit Japanese department store counter. A technician's hand is visible using a white electronic probe against her cheek while a digital tablet nearby displays complex data, including a red pentagonal radar chart and various skin quality metrics in Japanese text. (2) The scene shifts to a bathroom where the woman applies skincare products to her face; she holds a purple-labeled bottle of 'episteme Stem Science Oil' toward the camera, followed by a clean graphic showing three products labeled as Step 1, 2, and 3. The camera then captures the luxury brand's store display, featuring rows of purple and gold bottles under sleek, modern shelf lighting. (3) A detailed close-up shows hands holding the purple 'Stem Science Oil' bottle, dispensing a clear liquid onto the palm and rubbing it into the back of the hand to demonstrate its glossy, absorbable texture. The woman then applies the oil to her face with gentle upward motions, emphasizing her clear complexion under soft indoor lighting. (4) The focus moves to the 'Pore Newing Shot' product; a white probe is seen checking the pores on her nose before the white pump-action bottle is shown. A dollop of the light-colored cream is squeezed onto a hand, showing a smooth lotion-like consistency before the woman applies it to her cheeks and nose area. (5) Next, a golden tube of 'Eye Perfect Shot b' is featured in a close-up on a display stand, followed by the woman squeezing a tiny amount onto her fingertip. She carefully dabs and massages the cream around her eyes, looking directly into the camera while her hair is clipped back with white hair clips. (6) The final phase shows a box of 'Stem Science Drink' ampoules; the woman is seen drinking from a small blue vial using a straw in a cozy indoor setting. The video concludes with an promotional flyer for free samples and a brief shot of a skin test strip being placed on her cheek.

A subtle digital 'ding' sound effect highlights the appearance of text on screen during the skin test scene. (2) As the narrator transitions to describing the episteme skincare products, her speech rate remains fast and informative, maintaining high clarity. The BGM continues as a consistent rhythmic bed with synthesizers providing a bright, modern texture under the voice. (3) The final segment features the narrator explaining how to obtain free samples at a Japanese department store, ending with a slightly more excited pitch contour to encourage viewer action, while the music swells slightly in volume before a clean fade-out at the end of the clip.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem Identification (Skin Test) -> Solution Presentation (Product Introduction) -> Tutorial/Application -> Promotion/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional review for the Japanese skincare brand episteme. It uses a personal 'skin health' crisis as a narrative hook to introduce a multi-step anti-aging skincare routine tailored for mature skin. By showing the skin analysis results and the creator's direct application of the products, it aims to build trust in the brand's scientific efficacy and encourages viewers to claim free samples in Japan.
